items.title: Dynamic Creatures partners with Sixth Wall Studio to bring Hasbro characters to life with robots
items.summary: The companies will combine Sixth Wall’s character authoring and alignment with Dynamic Creatures’ mobile, expressive robots. The post Dynamic Creatures partners with Sixth Wall Studio to bring Hasbro characters to life with robots appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: Dynamic Creatures 与 Sixth Wall Studio 合作，通过机器人让孩之宝角色栩栩如生
items.summary_zh: 两家公司将把 Sixth Wall 的角色创作和协调与 Dynamic Creatures 的移动、富有表现力的机器人结合起来。 Dynamic Creatures 与 Sixth Wall Studio 合作，用机器人将孩之宝角色带入生活的帖子首先出现在《机器人报告》上。

items.title: Why predictive maintenance matters more as factories add robots
items.summary: As robotics scales across industries, companies need a maintenance strategy to collect and use the right data to minimize downtime. The post Why predictive maintenance matters more as factories add robots appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: 为什么随着工厂增加机器人，预测性维护变得更加重要
items.summary_zh: 随着机器人技术在各个行业的扩展，公司需要制定维护策略来收集和使用正确的数据，以最大限度地减少停机时间。 《为什么随着工厂添加机器人，预测性维护变得更加重要》一文首先出现在《机器人报告》上。

items.title: Intel and Altera expand collaboration to simplify sensor integration for physical AI
items.summary: Altera and Intel are working to make it easier to connect diverse sensors, turn data into real-time insights, and develop robotics. The post Intel and Altera expand collaboration to simplify sensor integration for physical AI appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: 英特尔和 Altera 扩大合作，简化物理 AI 的传感器集成
items.summary_zh: Altera 和英特尔正在努力让连接不同传感器、将数据转化为实时洞察以及开发机器人变得更加容易。英特尔和 Altera 扩大合作以简化物理 AI 传感器集成的帖子首先出现在《机器人报告》上。

items.title: Axon invests $1.2B into Skydio and becomes its U.S. public safety distributor
items.summary: The partners plan to bring Skydio drones to public safety agencies across the U.S. as Axon expands its Drone as First Responder program. The post Axon invests $1.2B into Skydio and becomes its U.S. public safety distributor appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: Axon 向 Skydio 投资 1.2B 美元并成为其美国公共安全经销商
items.summary_zh: 随着 Axon 扩大其无人机作为急救员计划，合作伙伴计划将 Skydio 无人机引入美国各地的公共安全机构。 Axon 向 Skydio 投资 1.2B 美元并成为其美国公共安全分销商的消息首先出现在《机器人报告》上。

items.title: NVIDIA launches GR00T 2 and Isaac Lab 3.0 at CoRL
items.summary: NVIDIA also gave a look at how its partners, like Ambi Robotics, FieldAI, Flexion, Skild AI, RLWRLD, and more, are using these technologies. The post NVIDIA launches GR00T 2 and Isaac Lab 3.0 at CoRL appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: NVIDIA 在 CoRL 推出 GR00T 2 和 Isaac Lab 3.0
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 还介绍了 Ambi Robotics、FieldAI、Flexion、Skild AI、RLWRLD 等合作伙伴如何使用这些技术。 NVIDIA 在 CoRL 推出 GR00T 2 和 Isaac Lab 3.0 的消息首先出现在《机器人报告》上。
